topIssues.title: <picture> element should allow aria-hidden
topIssues.bodyExcerpt:
A `<picture>` element is allowed to have aria-hidden since October 2021, per the [W3C Recommendation](https://www.w3.org/TR/html-aria/#:~:text=26%20October%202021%20%2D%20Addition%3A%20Allow%20aria%2Dhidden%20attribute%20on%20the%20picture%20element.).

```html
<picture aria-hidden="true"></picture>
